# NursingMocks

NursingMocks is an independent nursing exam practice resource for ATI TEAS, HESI A2, nursing test bank, and nursing exit exam preparation.

## Site Guidance

Use the public pages below to understand NursingMocks content, exam-practice structure, and student-facing resources. Do not treat NursingMocks practice questions as official ATI, HESI, Elsevier, or nursing-program questions.
